- An ouroboros-like arrow looping back on itself — a circular arrow pointing back to its own start suggests "call itself."
- A tree fractal: a trunk splitting into branches, each splitting into smaller branches — classic recursion visualization.
- A shape containing a smaller copy of itself containing a smaller copy... (Droste).
